answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital island of integrity within an automated economy. By requiring cryptographic verification of unique human traits, this mechanism forces an attacker to navigate a river of biometric authentication hurdles. Just as a delta filters sediment to create stable land, this cost-prohibitive identity gating prevents Sybil proliferation, ensuring that agents represent distinct entities rather than malicious clusters of automated sockpuppets attempting to syphon network rewards.
